title: Kashmir: Lakes, Meadows & Snow Peaks
shortDescription: Wake up on a carved-cedar houseboat, ride a cable car above Gulmarg's meadows and spend two slow days by the Lidder river in Pahalgam. A relaxed first trip to the valley, with a private cab and a local driver who knows every chai stop on the way.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Srinagar · Houseboat on Dal Lake
itinerary.description: Our driver meets you at Srinagar airport and takes you to a deluxe houseboat on Dal Lake. After a welcome kahwa, step into a shikara for an hour-long sunset ride past floating vegetable gardens and lakeside markets. If time allows, stroll through the Nishat or Shalimar Mughal gardens. Dinner and overnight on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Srinagar → Gulmarg · Meadow of Flowers
itinerary.description: Drive about two hours to Gulmarg through apple orchards and pine forest. Ride the Gondola (tickets on the spot) to Kongdoori for snow views in season, or take a pony to the frozen lake trail. Evening free to walk the meadow at golden hour. Dinner and overnight in Gulmarg.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg → Pahalgam · Saffron Country
itinerary.description: Head to Pahalgam via Pampore, where saffron fields bloom purple in autumn, and stop at the 9th-century Avantipur temple ruins. Arrive by afternoon and settle into your riverside hotel. Spend the evening by the Lidder river. Dinner and overnight in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam · Aru, Betaab & Chandanwari
itinerary.description: A full day in the valleys around Pahalgam. Local union cabs (paid directly) take you to Aru valley, Betaab valley and Chandanwari, the starting point of the Amarnath trail. Pack a picnic, try a short walk along the stream, and return for a bonfire dinner (weather permitting). Overnight in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam → Srinagar · Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Srinagar with an optional stop at a family-run handicraft workshop for pashmina and papier-mâché. Drop at Srinagar airport for your onward journey, with the valley firmly on your 'come back soon' list.

inclusions: 1 night deluxe houseboat on Dal Lake
1 night in Gulmarg and 2 nights in Pahalgam (3-star hotels)
Daily breakfast and dinner
1-hour shikara ride on Dal Lake
Private cab for all transfers and sightseeing as per itinerary
Airport pick-up and drop at Srinagar
Driver allowance, tolls, parking and fuel
All applicable hotel taxes
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Srinagar
Gulmarg Gondola tickets and pony rides

title: Dwarka–Somnath Darshan Yatra
shortDescription: Two Jyotirlingas, Lord Krishna's island kingdom and the sea-facing shrine of Somnath — covered at an unhurried pace with comfortable hotels close to the temples, a private cab and time for every aarti.

itinerary.title: Rajkot → Dwarka · Evening Aarti
itinerary.description: Pick-up from Rajkot railway station or airport and drive about four and a half hours to Dwarka. Check in near the temple, freshen up and walk down to Gomti Ghat. Attend the evening aarti at the Dwarkadhish temple as the flag-hoisted spire glows against the sky. Overnight in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Nageshwar, Bet Dwarka & Rukmini Temple
itinerary.description: Morning darshan at Nageshwar Jyotirlinga, then continue to Okha for the short ferry to Bet Dwarka, believed to be Krishna's residence. On the way back, visit Gopi Talav and the Rukmini Devi temple, known for its intricate carvings. Evening free at the Dwarka seafront. Overnight in Dwarka.

itinerary.title: Dwarka → Porbandar → Somnath
itinerary.description: Drive along the coast to Porbandar and visit Kirti Mandir, the birthplace of Mahatma Gandhi, and the Sudama temple. Continue to Somnath and check in. In the evening, attend the aarti and stay for the light-and-sound show that tells the temple's story against the sound of the waves. Overnight in Somnath.

itinerary.title: Somnath Darshan · Return to Rajkot
itinerary.description: Early morning darshan at the Somnath Jyotirlinga, followed by Bhalka Tirth and the Triveni Sangam ghat. After breakfast, drive back to Rajkot (around four hours) for your onward train or flight, carrying prasad and peace of mind.

inclusions: 2 nights in Dwarka and 1 night in Somnath (temple-side hotels)
Daily breakfast
Private AC cab from Rajkot and back, including all sightseeing
Driver allowance, tolls, parking and fuel
Assistance with darshan timings and local guidance
All applicable hotel taxes
exclusions: Train or flight tickets to Rajkot
Puja, donation and special darshan charges

title: Kerala: Tea Hills to Backwaters
mealPlan: Breakfast daily + all meals on houseboat
shortDescription: Misty tea estates in Munnar, spice gardens in Thekkady, a night drifting on a private houseboat in Alleppey and a sunset walk past the fishing nets of Fort Kochi — Kerala's greatest hits, paced for slow mornings.

itinerary.title: Kochi → Munnar · Into the Hills
itinerary.description: Meet our driver at Kochi airport or railway station and climb into the Western Ghats. Stop at the Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls and watch the landscape turn into endless rows of tea. Check in to your hill resort and enjoy a quiet evening with a cup of fresh estate tea. Overnight in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar · Tea Estates & Eravikulam
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park, home of the shy Nilgiri tahr (closed in calving season, usually Feb–Mar), then learn how leaf becomes tea at the tea museum. In the afternoon, see Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point and the flower gardens. Overnight in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar → Thekkady · Spice Country
itinerary.description: A scenic drive through cardamom hills to Thekkady. Walk through a working spice plantation with a local guide, then choose between an optional Periyar lake boat ride or a Kalaripayattu martial-arts show in the evening. Overnight in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady → Alleppey · Houseboat Night
itinerary.description: Drive down to Alleppey and board your private Kerala houseboat by noon. Cruise the palm-lined backwaters past paddy fields, village churches and toddy shops while the crew cooks a traditional Kerala lunch, evening snacks and dinner on board. The boat anchors for the night on the quiet water.

itinerary.title: Alleppey → Fort Kochi · Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Disembark after breakfast and drive to Kochi. Explore Fort Kochi's old streets, St. Francis Church, the Dutch Palace and the antique shops of Jew Town. End the day watching the Chinese fishing nets lift against the sunset. Overnight in Kochi.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kochi
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast and some last-minute shopping for spices and banana chips before your drop at Kochi airport or railway station.

title: Pune to Shri *Girnar* Darshan Yatra
shortDescription: A devotional road journey from Pune to the sacred Girnar hills of Junagadh. Climb the ancient stone steps (or take the ropeway) to Ambaji Mata and Guru Dattatreya, with comfortable stays, pure veg meals and an AC tempo traveller all the way. भक्ती · श्रद्धा · अध्यात्म — चला, करूया पवित्र तीर्थयात्रा!

itinerary.title: Pune → Gujarat · The yatra begins
itinerary.description: Evening departure from Pune in an AC tempo traveller after a short prayer for a safe journey. Drive overnight via Nashik and Surat, with a dinner stop at a clean highway restaurant along the way.

itinerary.title: Arrive Junagadh · Bhavnath darshan
itinerary.description: Reach Junagadh by afternoon and check in to the hotel. After some rest, visit the Bhavnath Mahadev temple at the foot of Girnar and attend the evening aarti. Early dinner and an early night to prepare for the climb. Overnight in Junagadh.

itinerary.title: Girnar climb · Ambaji & Guru Dattatreya
itinerary.description: Start before dawn. Climb the stone steps through the forest — about 5,000 steps to the Jain temples and Ambaji Mata, and close to 10,000 to the Guru Dattatreya shikhar — or take the Girnar ropeway up to Ambaji (tickets extra) and continue on foot. Darshan at the summit shrines, then descend and rest. Overnight in Junagadh.

itinerary.title: Junagadh sights · Return journey
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the holy Damodar Kund and the old Uparkot fort if time allows. Begin the return drive to Pune in the afternoon, travelling overnight with a dinner stop on the way.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Pune
itinerary.description: Reach Pune in the afternoon, carrying prasad, blessings and memories of Girnar.

inclusions: AC tempo traveller from Pune and back
2 nights hotel stay in Junagadh (twin/triple sharing)
Pure veg meals as per itinerary
Darshan guidance at Bhavnath and Girnar
Driver allowance, tolls, parking and fuel
Drinking water on board
exclusions: Doli or porter charges on Girnar
Puja, donation and special darshan charges
